script_text: Stop, Capricorn—the partnership sky just cracked wide open. Jupiter is retrograde in Cancer, opposing your Earth sign from the 7th House of Partnerships, while Saturn, your ruling planet, has just turned direct in Aquarius and is sextiling Uranus in Taurus, tightening your 2nd House money line. The Sun in Gemini in your 6th House is sextiling Mars in Sagittarius in the 12th, so a behind-the-scenes work contact is moving faster than you realize. In love, a taken Capricorn may face a serious commitment talk, even a move-in or engagement signal; single Capricorns attract someone generous, protective, and financially established through family or a client. Career and money: a 10th House decision can unlock an irregular payment, bonus, or creative royalty, but do not co-sign anything until the contract is reviewed. Unexpected blessing: an old contact returns with leverage. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
